excluded.reason: Roofing-felt sheet with strong horizontal bands and near-white (very rough) roughness, so it doesn't read as glossy tar. Replaced by ambientcg/Ground051. License was CC0, so this was not a rights issue.
Page checked: CC0 (https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-audio). It overlaps Interface Sounds (older, 50 files), so it was left out to keep the set to 3 packs.
Excluded by brief: Quaternius's current license restricts redistribution. No Quaternius files were fetched.
Modern painted oil and plastic drums (one has a hazard decal); off-style for bog-gothic.
Hurricane lantern at 33.9k polys; wooden_lantern_01 fits the market better and is lighter.
Modern fluorescent tube fixture (it has chains, but the style is off-period). hanging_industrial_lamp chosen instead.
Modern gantry crane at about 90k polys; too heavy and too modern for a fighting-game backdrop.
Decorative driveway gate at 38k polys; not needed for the four stages.
Saturated lawn-green moss carpets that read garish in the dark palette.
Considered for tar. Its normal map is almost flat and it reads as road aggregate up close, so Ground051 was chosen.
Emissive lava with glowing cracks, not tar.
They match a 'bone' search but are skull warning signs, not a bone surface.
Chainmail fabric, not hanging chains. No standalone chain texture or model was found on ambientCG or Poly Haven.
Brick alternatives; factory_brick fits the sooty industrial brief best. Style choice, not a rights issue.
Open, see-through weave; hessian_380 is denser and better for awnings.
HDRI alternatives. kloppenheim_04 carries an artificial light-pollution glow; lakeside_night (shore and dead trees in water) suits the Sump better. Others were redundant.

not_found: Chains: no CC0 chain texture or model on ambientCG or Poly Haven. The only chain is the short one on polyhaven/hanging_industrial_lamp.
Bone: no dedicated bone texture on either site. ambientcg/Ivory001B (smooth ivory) is the stand-in and needs a porous detail normal or tint to read as weathered bone.
Tar: no dedicated tar or bitumen-pool texture fits. ambientcg/Ground051 (viscous dark mud) is the base to tint near-black and make glossy in the material.

Whooshes: none of the three Kenney packs has a dedicated whoosh/swing set; RPG Audio cloth and drawKnife are the closest. Kenney's other CC0 packs were not surveyed beyond the four named in the brief.
